capabilities: Translate selected text in PDFs and Markdown notes
Switch between local Ollama, OpenAI-compatible cloud APIs, Google and Bing
Add persistent PDF highlight annotations in five colors with notes
Provide a sidebar panel for typed text or the current selection
Set a custom translation prompt and source/target languages
extras: Free Google/Bing services are rate-limited; cloud API keys are held in Obsidian SecretStorage; version 0.5.1 requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later, and the README includes Windows setup notes and a troubleshooting FAQ.
problem: Obsidian's PDF reader has no built-in way to translate a selected passage, so readers must copy text into an outside translator and lose their place.

relations.evidence: Local LLM (Ollama) — Private, offline, unlimited usage
Google Translate / Bing Translate — No config needed, one-click switch
To connect llama-server, use Cloud API → OpenAI Compatible
Cloud API (OpenAI-Compatible) — Connect DeepSeek, OpenRouter, and more

summary: Translates selected PDF or Markdown text through local Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, or Google/Bing, showing results in a popup or sidebar panel.
